pr-number.description: Pull request number to comment on. Pass github.event.pull_request.number.

k9-verdict.description: needs.<k9 job>.outputs.verdict — green, yellow, orange, red or grey.

k9-artifact.description: Artifact name carrying k9-grid/report.md. Empty to skip the download.

hypatia-verdict.description: needs.<hypatia job>.outputs.verdict — green, yellow, orange, red, purple or grey.

hypatia-artifact.description: Artifact name carrying verdict-grid/report.md. Empty to skip the download.

hypatia-advisory.description: needs.<hypatia job>.outputs.advisory — `<state>:<critical>:<high>` or `none`. Shown beside the verdict so an advisory critical is visible without being able to grade the change. Empty is fine.

grid-author.description: The account whose previous comment is read as the baseline. Only this account's comment is trusted.

canon-ref.description: Ref of metadatastician/standards holding the renderer. Leave EMPTY to use this reusable's own commit (job.workflow_sha), which is the standards commit the caller pinned. Setting it to a branch (the old default, "main") makes every already-pinned caller run whatever standards pushed most recently — a float, not a pin; a 40-hex commit is accepted when a caller deliberately needs another one.

steps.name: Fetch the coverage helper independently of canon-ref
Render the combined verdict
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
[ -f "$RENDERER" ] || { echo "::error::renderer not found at $RENDERER"; exit 1; }
# Read metadata only, never code from a PR. API failure is an explicit
# unknown coverage snapshot and must not suppress the three lane grids.
coverage="$RUNNER_TEMP/reviewer-coverage.md"
printf '%s\n' '**External reviewer coverage:** INDETERMINATE — evidence unavailable; no approval inferred.' > "$coverage"
if [[ "$PR_NUMBER" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] &&
   head=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER" --jq .head.sha) &&
   gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/reviews?per_page=100" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/reviews.json" &&
   gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments?per_page=100" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/review-comments.json" &&
   checked_head=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER" --jq .head.sha); then
  helper="$COVERAGE_HELPER"
  if [ -f "$helper" ]; then
    bash "$helper" "$head" "$RUNNER_TEMP/reviews.json" \
      "$RUNNER_TEMP/review-comments.json" "$checked_head" > "$coverage.new" || true
    [ ! -s "$coverage.new" ] || mv "$coverage.new" "$coverage"
  fi
fi
args=(--out "$RUNNER_TEMP/fork-governance"
      --deed-result "$DEED_RESULT"
      --k9-result "$K9_RESULT" --k9-verdict "$K9_VERDICT"
      --hypatia-result "$HYPATIA_RESULT" --hypatia-verdict "$HYPATIA_VERDICT"
      --hypatia-advisory "${HYPATIA_ADVISORY:-}"
      --sha "$GITHUB_SHA" --run "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY")
[ -s k9-grid/report.md ] && args+=(--k9-report k9-grid/report.md)
[ -s verdict-grid/report.md ] && args+=(--hypatia-report verdict-grid/report.md)
bash "$RENDERER" "${args[@]}" >/dev/null
# Older canon-ref renderers do not accept coverage arguments. Append
# outside the versioned renderer, only within the publisher's budget.
body="$RUNNER_TEMP/fork-governance/body.md"
# Recent older renderers emit this exact trailing fallback when no
# coverage argument is supplied. Remove only that known footer;
# lane text containing the same words remains untouched.
if awk -v legacy='**External reviewer coverage:** INDETERMINATE — not collected; no review or approval inferred.' '
  { lines[NR]=$0 }
  END {
    last=NR
    while (last>0 && lines[last]=="") last--
    if (lines[last]==legacy) { last--; for (i=1;i<=last;i++) print lines[i] }
    else { exit 3 }
  }' "$body" > "$body.new"; then
  mv "$body.new" "$body"
else
  status=$?
  rm -f "$body.new"
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ] || exit "$status"
fi
# Always append our own section. Lane finding text is untrusted and
# cannot suppress it by mentioning reviewer coverage or its marker.
marker='<!-- fork-governance:reviewer-coverage -->'
# Reserve 2048 bytes for the fork publisher notice and run stamp.
if [ "$(( $(wc -c < "$body") + $(wc -c < "$coverage") + ${#marker} + 2 ))" -le 62952 ]; then
    printf '\n%s\n' "$marker" >> "$body"
    cat "$coverage" >> "$body"
else
    echo '::warning::Reviewer coverage omitted to preserve the governance comment size budget.'
fi
{
  echo "## Fork governance"
  echo
  cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/fork-governance/body.md"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Decide who posts
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -n "$HEAD_REPO" ] && [ "$HEAD_REPO" != "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" ]; then
  echo "fork=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "Fork pull request ($HEAD_REPO): the comment is handed to the workflow_run publisher."
else
  echo "fork=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Package the comment for the publisher
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
jq -n --arg pr "$PR_NUMBER" --arg sha "$HEAD_SHA" --arg run "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
  '{pr_number: $pr, head_sha: $sha, run_id: $run}' \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/fork-governance/meta.json"

steps.name: Upload the comment for the publisher
Publish the comment
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# One comment per pull request, updated in place. The marker is read
# before the body is written, so a rerun of the same commit cannot
# produce two comments and a reader cannot see two verdicts at once.
comment_id=$(gh api --paginate --slurp "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments" \
  | jq -r --arg a "$GRID_AUTHOR" \
      '[.[][] | select((.user.login // "") == $a and ((.body // "") | contains("<!-- fork-governance-verdict:")))]
       | last | .id // ""')
jq -n --rawfile body "$RUNNER_TEMP/fork-governance/body.md" '{body: $body}' \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/fork-governance/comment.json"
if [ -n "$comment_id" ]; then
  gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/comments/$comment_id" \
    --input "$RUNNER_TEMP/fork-governance/comment.json" >/dev/null
  echo "updated the fork governance comment on #$PR_NUMBER ($comment_id)"
else
  gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments" \
    --input "$RUNNER_TEMP/fork-governance/comment.json" >/dev/null
  echo "posted the fork governance comment on #$PR_NUMBER"
fi
